title: Hardrock 100 Lodging and Camping in Silverton
claims: Camping Hardrock is a free community option at the Kendall Mountain Recreation Area in Silverton, with room for 180 vehicles and tents; RVs, Sprinters and trailers are limited to 30.
Pre-registration is required for Camping Hardrock; the ski lodge offers limited general use including water, bathrooms and electricity.
Camping Hardrock registration for 2027 opens in May 2027.
Silverton's public shower house at Anesi Park is open 7a-8p daily; 5 USD buys one token for 5 minutes, cash only.
Ouray offers lodging options and does not face the same lodging pressure as Silverton during Hardrock.
The page points to Silverton Chamber of Commerce listings and to Cascade Village and Purgatory Resort between Silverton and Durango.
